description: List Gmail message ids matching a Gmail search query (for example 'from:alice is:unread newer_than:7d'). Returns message + thread ids only, never message content; use gmail_get_message for one message's content once you have its id. Defaults to 500 results, matching Gmail's own real single-call maximum (Google, current as of this writing) -- there is no acknowledge_default_limit_override/row_limit pair on this verb, since the default already sits at the vendor's per-call ceiling. Requires a connected account (run connect_account first).
embedding_description: Search the connected Gmail mailbox and return matching message identifiers. Accepts a Gmail query string using Gmail's native search operators (from, to, subject, is:unread, has:attachment, newer_than, label). Returns a list of {id, thread_id} plus a count -- never message content, up to 500/call (Gmail's own single-call ceiling). Pair with gmail_get_message for one message's content.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with a messages list of {id, thread_id} and a count.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize how many messages matched. List a few ids; suggest gmail_get_message to read one. Treat message ids as low-sensitivity.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List Gmail messages matching a search query.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.not_connected: no Google account linked. gsuite.auth_expired: the stored refresh token was revoked. gsuite.rate_limited: Google throttled the request.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.not_connected / gsuite.auth_expired: run connect_account to (re)link the account. gsuite.rate_limited: back off and retry.
